title.narrative: TB PROGRAM - Belarus (01-Jan-2016-31-Dec-2018)

description.narrative: Belarus, Tuberculosis, Republican Scientific and Practical Center for Medical Technologies, Informatization, Administration and Management of Health (RSPC MT)This program has the following goals: To reduce the burden of tuberculosis in Belarus by ensuring universal access to rapid laboratory diagnosis of TB and M/XDR-TB and universal coverage of M/XDR-TB patients with high-quality treatment, through strengthening patient-centered approaches in out. The objectives of this program are: Health system strengthening by introducing new funding models of the ambulatory TB care. To enhance coverage of M/XDR-TB patients with high-quality treatment. To ensure universal access to high-quality rapid laboratory diagnosis of all forms of TB, including M/XDR-TB. To improve management of HIV-associated tuberculosis. To improve MDR-TB treatment outcomes with appropriate patient-centered support, including patients from high-risk groups and vulnerable populations. To strengthen National monitoring and evaluation system, National TB program management for improved performance of TB control program

title.narrative: Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for BLR-T-RSPCMTP01
Number of cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB that began second-line treatment
Number of TB cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB notified
Percentage of cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB started on treatment for MDR-TB who were lost to follow up during the first six months of treatment
Number of cases of XDR TB enrolled on treatment

MDR TB-Other 2:Interim treatment success rate of pre- and XDR-TB cases: Percentage of bacteriologically confirmed preand extra-drug resistant TB cases who have negative culture at the end of 6 months of treatment
Percentage of HIV-positive registered TB patients given anti-retroviral therapy during TB treatment
Percentage of TB patients who had an HIV test result recorded in the TB register
Percentage of previously treated TB patients receiving DST (bacteriologically positive cases only)
Percentage of new and relapse TB patients tested using WHO recommended rapid tests at the time of diagnosis
Impact indicators targets and results for BLR-T-RSPCMTP01
TB mortality rate per 100,000 population
RR-TB and/or MDR-TB prevalence among new TB patients: Proportion of new TB patients with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB
TB I-other 1: MDR prevalence among previously treated TB patients
Outcome indicators targets and results for BLR-T-RSPCMTP01
Case notification rate per 100,000 population- bacteriologically-confirmed TB, new and relapse
Case notification rate of all forms of TB per 100,000 population - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, new and relapse cases
Treatment success rate of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB: Percentage of patients with RR and/or MDR-TB successfully treated
